maya (Docs): Pushed PR to add an onprem migration note about proxy chaining and HSM failures: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512. Need quick tech checks on examples and an APK/snippet for air-gapped installs.

cale (Eng-Platform): Quick notes: include distro PKCS#11 default paths (/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so, /usr/lib64/pkcs11/), and emphasize port mappings in systemd unit for the HSM daemon.

isa (SRE): Reproduced the failure when TLS is terminated mid-chain: HSM attestation returns `PKCS11: CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID`. Recommend showing the failing log and the working log for diff.

sam (Security): Add the TLS verify command for ops: `openssl s_client -connect kms.local:443 -servername kms.local | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256`. Also include a short note: do not use insecureSkipVerify in production.

maya (Docs): Adding nftables snippet for SNI passthrough pattern and a small shell check to validate mirrored bundles in air-gapped setups:
`sha256sum -c /var/lib/redwood-offline/installer.sha256 || exit 1`

ci-bot: PR #512 checks: markdown-lint OK, linkcheck 1 warning (systemd unit path).

cale (Eng-Platform): I'll move the installer.service example to /assets/units and update the link. Once that's in, LGTM from infra side.

maya (Docs): Thanks all — will squash fixups and merge after link is updated.
